The stock of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) hit a new 52-week high and has $210.50 target or 9.00 % above today’s $193.12 share price. The 5 months bullish chart indicates low risk for the $949.21B company. The 1-year high was reported on Jun, 5 by Barchart.com . If the $210.50 price target is reached, the company will be worth $85.43B more. The 52-week high event is an important milestone for every stock because it shows very positive momentum and is time when buyers come in. During such notable technical setup, fundamental investors usually stay away and are careful shorting or selling the stock.
The stock increased 0.67% or $1.29 during the last trading session, reaching $193.12. About 3.91M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 5, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.

AAPL’s profit will be $10.76B for 22.05 P/E if the $2.19 EPS becomes a reality. Apple Inc. designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, personal computers, and portable digital music players to consumers, small and mid-sized businesses, and education, enterprise, and government clients worldwide. The company has market cap of $949.21 billion. The firm also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications. It has a 18.68 P/E ratio. It offers iPhone, a line of smartphones; iPad, a line of multi-purpose tablets; and Mac, a line of desktop and portable personal computers.
